chunks: Ahmad, from 'Ali ibn al-Hakam, from 'Abd Allah ibn Yahya al-Kahili, who said:

I asked Aba 'Abd Allah عليه السلام about a woman with whom a man has intercourse, then she begins menstruating while she is in the place of غسل; should she perform ghusl or not? He said: "That which invalidates salat has come, so she should not perform ghusl."

key_terms.الْمَرْأَةِ: the woman being asked about in the legal ruling
key_terms.الْمُغْتَسَلِ: the place or circumstance of performing ghusl
key_terms.فَلَا تَغْتَسِلُ: so she should not perform ghusl
key_terms.يُفْسِدُ الصَّلَاةَ: that which invalidates or prevents salat

ai.seo_question: If a woman begins menstruation before completing ghusl from janabah, should she still perform ghusl?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning a woman who begins menstruation at the time of ghusl following intercourse. Imam al-Sadiq عليه السلام states that because menstruation has commenced, which prevents salat, she is not to perform that ghusl at that time.
